explanation: The demonstration runs the production gatherResearch workflow against an already stored source.
Its fetch dependency is replaced with a deterministic HTTP 503 error, so no live request occurs.
Fetching and processing happen before ResearchRepository.saveSource is called.
saveSource replaces a source and its chunks inside one SQLite transaction and rolls back on error.
The displayed last attempted time is separate from the unchanged last successful retrieval time.
